about.title: About {{siteName}}
about.label: About
about.description: {{siteName}} is a long-form knowledge community organized by tags, with Markdown and LaTeX writing backed by Git version control.

position.title: What Rinspace is for
position.line1: {{siteName}} supports long-term knowledge organization, blogging, book notes, tag Wikis, questions, and discussions.
position.line2: Tags form the core of its knowledge structure so that content, citations, and version changes remain traceable.

legal.title: Legal information
legal.label: Legal
legal.description: {{siteName}} operator details, regulatory records, and public contact information.

links.title: Related pages
links.line1: The Terms, Privacy Policy, and copyright reporting rules are available from the links at the bottom of this page.
links.line2: For site feedback, content rights, or security issues, contact us through the public email address.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.label: Terms
terms.description: Basic rules for publishing, editing, citing, and interacting with content on {{siteName}}.

account.title: Accounts and content
account.line1: Users are responsible for the content they publish, edit, upload, or submit and must respect the lawful rights of others.
account.line2: Users must not publish unlawful content, harassment, spam, privacy violations, or material that disrupts the service.

knowledge.title: Knowledge and citations
knowledge.line1: {{siteName}} supports Markdown, LaTeX, tag Wikis, and Git versioning; users must respect attribution and citation standards.
knowledge.line2: The platform may process public content as needed for display, indexing, backup, moderation, and security.

enforcement.title: Enforcement
enforcement.line1: Content that violates these rules may be hidden or removed, and publishing or account capabilities may be restricted or referred for review.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.description: How {{siteName}} handles basic account, content, log, and contact information.

collection.title: Information collected
collection.line1: {{siteName}} processes the account data, content data, and activity logs needed for sign-in, publishing, editing, comments, notifications, security audits, and abuse prevention.
collection.line2: Email addresses, avatars, profiles, posts, comments, tag edits, and uploaded files are displayed or stored according to the visibility selected by the user.

purpose.title: How information is used
purpose.line1: Information is used to provide the service, preserve content versions, handle reports, protect security, improve the product, and meet legal obligations.
purpose.line2: Personal information is not used for purposes unrelated to {{siteName}} unless required by law, authorized by the user, or necessary for security.

rights.title: Access and correction
rights.line1: To access, correct, or delete personal information, or to ask a privacy question, email {{email}}.

copyright.title: Copyright and infringement reports
copyright.label: Copyright
copyright.description: {{siteName}} copyright principles and the channel for reporting infringement.

principles.title: Copyright principles
principles.line1: {{siteName}} respects original work, academic citation, open-source licenses, and lawful republication.
principles.line2: Before publishing, users must hold the relevant rights, have permission, or rely on another lawful basis such as fair use, citation, or an open-source license.

materials.title: What to include in a report
materials.line1: If content on {{siteName}} infringes your rights, provide the URL, proof of rights, an explanation of the infringement, and a contact email.

handling.title: How reports are handled
handling.line1: After validating a report, we may remove or hide content, restrict access, contact the publisher, or preserve necessary evidence.

contact.title: Contact
contact.label: Contact
contact.description: {{siteName}} public email address and common reasons to contact us.

email.title: Public email
email.line2: Use it for site feedback, account issues, content or copyright reports, security matters, and business inquiries.

handling.title: Sending a useful report
handling.line1: Include relevant page links, account details, screenshots, and any context needed to investigate the issue.
handling.line2: For rights or security reports, clearly identify the affected scope and provide information that can be verified.
